# Recorded disposable discovery qualification

These exact Python stdin programs were run on the owner-authorized test VM.
The SSH destination is deliberately outside the repository. The upgrade recipe
installs immutable unsigned development RPMs and starts only the isolated test
coordinator. It is not a generally reusable installer or permission to mutate a
new host. Preserve all existing guests, source media and durable operations.

The first observation harness used an incorrect resource key. Its failure and
partial private observations are retained. The second uses the documented
`resourceUUID` field and fresh filenames; it passed native CLI/TUI comparisons
and state preservation. Observation scripts perform read-only checks and write
only private evidence artifacts. Never silently overwrite a previous run.

See `docs/evidence/discovery-plugin-run.md` and the append-only ledger for exact
code, artifacts, results and remaining qualification. No raw inventory, disk
contents, private keys or TUI transcripts are included here.
